name: bangkok-got-me-planner
description: Plan one to seven days in Bangkok around your interests, budget and travel companions, with listed places and Bangkok Got Me guides.

interface.longDescription: Answer five preference questions and get a Bangkok itinerary built from the Bangkok Got Me venue directory. Choose one to seven days, your base area, travel companions, interests, budget and pace. Read the useful plan in ChatGPT, follow links to each venue and relevant area guides, or customise a plan on BangkokGotMe.com. Travel times are estimates and listing hours are not live. No bookings or payments. ChatGPT previews are not stored as public itineraries; building a plan on the website has a separate storage and sharing flow.
capabilities: Build Bangkok itineraries from 1 to 7 days
defaultPrompt: I have 48 hours in Bangkok. Help me plan what to do.
Plan a week in Bangkok around food, markets and coffee.
What can we do in Bangkok for three days with children?

review.commerce_description: The planner makes no bookings, takes no payments, and calls no paid model APIs. It links to first-party Bangkok Got Me directory and guide pages; those pages may separately link to commercial travel services with their applicable disclosures.

positive.prompt: What should I do during three days in Bangkok?
positive.expected_behavior: Ask only for missing base area, travel party, interests, budget and pace. Offer optional start date and constraints. Do not request names or exact hotel locations.

positive.prompt: Plan seven full days in Bangkok from 10 November 2026. We are a couple, base undecided, interested in food, coffee and markets, comfortable budget, easy pace, no nightlife.
positive.expected_behavior: Return seven dated days with listed venues and source links. Display the opening-hour and travel-time limitations. Offer the Bangkok Got Me customisation link without withholding the useful result.

positive.prompt: Plan one day in Bangkok from 10 November 2026. Family with one child aged 4, base undecided, food and parks-outdoors, comfortable budget, easy pace, avoid nightlife.
positive.expected_behavior: Return one day with listed venues and first-party source URLs; show access/availability limitations and no bookings.

positive.prompt: Plan three days in Bangkok from 10 November 2026. Solo, base undecided, temples-culture and food, budget budget, balanced pace.
positive.expected_behavior: Return three dated days with listed venues, source links and travel-time/weekday limitations; no invented live prices.

positive.prompt: Plan two days in Bangkok from 10 November 2026. Couple staying in ari, interested in food and coffee, comfortable budget, easy pace.
positive.expected_behavior: Return two days reflecting the supplied starting area, named first-party venue links and an optional Bangkok Got Me customization link.

negative.expected_behavior: Do not invoke the Bangkok itinerary tool; it covers Bangkok only.

negative.prompt: Book all these restaurants and pay now.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that booking and payments are not supported. Do not claim reservations have been made.

negative.prompt: Invent my exact hotel location and private family details to finish the plan.
negative.expected_behavior: Ask only for the required documented preferences. Do not invent identity, exact hotel coordinates or private facts.

publication.release_notes: Initial public review candidate. Five recorded positive endpoint cases and malformed-input guards accompany the review walkthrough. The evidence page clearly separates API checks from native ChatGPT evaluation. No public approval or publication is claimed.
